description.value: La Tortilleria is a Mexican food counter located inside the Granville Island Public Market, serving fresh, made-daily dishes including burritos, tacos, enchiladas, and slow-rotisserie chicken with a house marinade. The stall also offers a full deli takeout menu — house-made salsas, guacamole, tortillas, and sauces — suitable for provisioning on the go. Its location at the heart of Granville Island makes it a natural pit stop for cyclists riding the False Creek seawall.
